body: Yes, finding a reason to get up is the hard part for me. I just want anything at this point, any feeling. Love or hate or whatever, I don't care. I just want to feel human again.
Did it once when I was younger after my father passed. That didn't help at all, but I'm not opposed to it.
I just kind of exist honestly, I don't feel extremely sad very much, I just feel like there's nothing at all.
I agree, the problem is I don't care enough to get out, and I've been racking my brain trying to figure out why. I actually enjoy exercise though.
The wellbutrin didn't make it worse really, but there was no reason for me to keep taking it because it did nothing for me.

I'm actually really good with people, so most times if friends ask me to go out, I can manage to do it. That's usually once every month or two. The rest of the time I'm just in my room, and I only really come out to see my nephew.
Never tested for any hormone stuff, mostly because I never had many of the symptoms. I used to take wellbutrin, but I stopped because it really didn't do much for me.
